executor.description: Executor instance identifier, such as codex:local or opencode:<serverId>; null when unknown for a legacy run.

executorKind.description: Executor implementation used for the run: codex, opencode or claude.

provider.description: Observed provider ID; null when unknown, including legacy runs and executors that do not expose a provider. Null does not identify a different provider.

model.description: Native model ID used by the executor; null when unknown.

selectionModel.description: Catalog selection ID used to select the model; may differ from the native model ID; null when unknown.

description: Cross-repository model identity for a workflowd agent run.
